name: chartworkai
description: The governance layer for agentic work — repo-native charter, decisions, handoffs and phase gates for long-running projects.

data-science.description: Quantitative analysis / research pipeline producing reproducible figures, tables, and a report.
data-science.reproducibility: byte-identical rebuild from raw via the project's verify command

software-app.description: Software or web/app project whose deliverable is running, deployable software.
software-app.reproducibility: build + automated tests pass via the project's verify command (e.g. a build + test target)

database.reproducibility: deterministic rebuild from raw meeting stated quality baselines (row counts, key uniqueness, referential integrity) via the verify command

competition-ml.description: Leaderboard/competition ML; deliverable is a scored submission + experiment log.
competition-ml.reproducibility: the submitted artifact regenerates from a recorded run (fixed seeds, recoverable split, or a cloud run/job URI + image digest)

investigation.description: Investigative / knowledge-base; deliverable is an evidence-backed dataset or report.
investigation.reproducibility: every published claim traces to an archived source at a stated evidence tier

deployed-service.description: A deployed service/app with cloud infrastructure.
deployed-service.reproducibility: config + image digest + job/run URI trace a live release back to a commit, with a tested rollback

compliance_checks: universal required files and directories exist
data-contract triad required only for data profiles (data-science, database, competition-ml)
at least one seed decision exists
handoff README or at least one handoff exists
no duplicate H2 headings in living documents
no unresolved placeholder tokens in active docs/config (the framework repo prunes its own templates/agents/prompts)
TASKS.md has exactly one In Progress section
TASKS.md uses checkbox bullets instead of Markdown tables
docs/phase_plan.md current phase number appears in PROJECT_CHARTER.md
decision files are linked from PROJECT_CHARTER.md
